description: Horaires de bus pour les 14 jours à venir SAEIV is a dataset listed in DataHub Métropole de Bordeaux open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Bordeaux Métropole. Dictionnaire Public Ce jeu de données non graphique issu du Systèmes d'Aide à l'Exploitation et d'Information des Voyageurs (SAEIV) représente les horaires de bus pour les 14 jours à venir. En raison de la forte volumétrie de ce jeu, nous exposons uniquement cette donnée via nos Webservice BM. Coverage: Bordeaux Métropole. The portal files it under Transports/mobilité. Its keywords are temps réel, arrêt, transport, bus, saeiv, horaire. The portal shows 2023-03-27 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-datahub-bordeaux-metropole-fr-portal.
